tools.name: add_employee
tools.description:
Add an employee. Required: first_name, last_name, email (unique), role,
    title, home_address, country_code (e.g. 'US'). Optional: organization (one
    of IBM, IBM partner, Red Hat), department_id, manager_id, salary,
    salary_currency, start_date (YYYY-MM-DD).
    Returns the employee dict or {"error": ...}.

tools.name: update_employee
tools.description:
Update any provided employee fields (others left unchanged).
    Returns the updated employee dict or {"error": ...}.

tools.name: get_employee
tools.description: Return the full employee dict for user_id, or {"error": ...}.

tools.name: list_employees
tools.description:
List employees filtered by any of department_id, manager_id,
    country_code. Returns a list of employee dicts limited to user_id,
    first_name, last_name, role, organization, title, department_id,
    manager_id, and country_code (email, home_address, salary,
    salary_currency, and start_date are omitted).

tools.name: get_manager
tools.description: Return the employee's manager dict, null if top of tree, or {"error":...}.

tools.name: get_direct_reports
tools.description: Return the list of employees who report directly to user_id.

tools.name: get_reporting_chain
tools.description: Return managers from immediate up to the top (excludes the employee).

tools.name: add_department
tools.description: Add a department (unique name). Returns the department dict.

tools.name: update_department
tools.description: Update a department's name and/or description.

tools.name: get_department
tools.description: Return the department dict for department_id.

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: Return all departments.

tools.name: set_passport
tools.description: Set (upsert) the employee's passport. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: update_passport
tools.description: Update provided passport fields.

tools.name: get_passport
tools.description: Return the employee's passport dict, or null if none set.

tools.name: set_visa
tools.description: Set (upsert) the employee's visa. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: update_visa
tools.description: Update provided visa fields.

tools.name: get_visa
tools.description: Return the employee's visa dict, or null if none set.

tools.name: set_emergency_contact
tools.description:
Set (upsert) the employee's emergency contact. relationship must be one
    of: Spouse, Parent, Sibling, Child, Relative, Friend, Guardian, Partner.

tools.name: update_emergency_contact
tools.description: Update provided emergency-contact fields (relationship validated).

tools.name: get_emergency_contact
tools.description: Return the employee's emergency contact dict, or null if none set.

tools.name: set_bank_account
tools.description: Set (upsert) the employee's bank account.

tools.name: update_bank_account
tools.description: Update provided bank-account fields.

tools.name: get_bank_account
tools.description: Return the employee's bank account dict, or null if none set.

tools.name: set_leave_allotment
tools.description:
Set annual allotment for a leave_type (Vacation, Sick Leave, Maternity,
    Paternity, Jury Duty, Unpaid). annual_days null = untracked.

tools.name: get_leave_allotments
tools.description: Return all leave allotment dicts for the employee.

tools.name: create_time_off_request
tools.description:
Create a Pending time-off request. leave_type from the fixed set; dates
    YYYY-MM-DD with end_date >= start_date. Returns the request dict.

tools.name: update_time_off_status
tools.description: Set a request's status to Pending, Approved, or Denied.

tools.name: get_time_off_request
tools.description: Return the time-off request dict for request_id.

tools.name: list_time_off_requests
tools.description: List time-off requests filtered by user_id and/or status.

tools.name: get_leave_balance
add_holiday
tools.description: Add a country holiday (holiday_date YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the holiday dict.

tools.name: list_holidays
tools.description: List holidays for a country, optionally filtered to a year.

tools.name: delete_holiday
tools.description: Delete a holiday by id. Returns {"deleted": bool}.
